notes.title: Notice of the Domestic Game Challenge Reward Activity
notes.content:
Dear players, the welfare storm is coming with great force! A mysterious big shot, with a passionate heart for domestic games, has launched this grand challenge event. There are numerous exciting gifts waiting for you to win! ​
Activity Rules
Game Achievement Challenge: Choose any one of the four ingenious domestic games, "Ancient Elegance", "Princess Gou Ba Rhapsodom", "Princess Dongfang and Expedition", and "Double Heroes' Legacy", to unlock all your achievements and write your game legend with your strength! ​
2. Game duration test: Accumulate 3 hours or more of playtime in the selected games, deeply immerse yourself in the elaborately crafted game world, and feel the charm of every detail. ​
3. Share game insights: After completing your achievements, go to the Steam game page and leave your genuine comments. Whether it's praise or suggestions, they can all inject new vitality into the game. ​

This reward is not only an acknowledgement of everyone's gaming skills, but also aims to promote the subsequent improvement and optimization of the game. Looking back over the past two years, from hand-drawing to the iterative upgrade of AI technology, every step of growth has been inseparable from the support of players. We are not a big company. We have made it this far all thanks to the company and encouragement of all our players. Every reward is our gratitude and repayment to all of you. Every reward carries our expectations for the future of the game. We hope that through everyone's participation and feedback, it will help us refine the game even more perfectly and achieve a transformation from zero to one and from something to something excellent. ​

Reward collection method
When you successfully complete the above three challenges, contact the administrator immediately, show the game achievement mark, duration record and screenshot of the Steam review, and you can participate in the event! ​
Don't hesitate any longer. Start this domestic game challenge journey right away. Fight for your passion and contribute to the development of domestic games. Who knows, the lucky prize might just win at your home!

notes.title: About the protagonist line simulation business construction novice guide
notes.content:
Due to the consideration of some players on the simulation of building games lack of experience. So here is some guidance to play, if you are familiar with this kind of play. You can play the game as you wish
1. After entering the protagonist line of the game, you can first build a farm (you can automatically harvest the required food, you can manually plant food or cash crops after entering the scene - workshop (you can automatically generate stone wood, you can enter the scene manually obtain wood and rare ores and fishing) - residential buildings (daily output of the number of people used for construction)
2. The daily amount of food consumed by the population in the city can be checked from the main office of the city to rationally plan consumption
3. After the completion of the three major buildings (farm workshops and residential buildings), it is recommended to construct the grid building (scientific and technological development) -- market (the main economic source, which needs corresponding technology).
4. After the completion of the above buildings, the resources are relatively mature, and the construction of workshops (tool manufacturing) barracks (recruiting soldiers) school workshops (upgrading soldiers) and miraculous aircraft battalions (military equipment) can be considered to assist the city defense and improve the mining efficiency.
5. After the completion of the above buildings, the resources are relatively mature, and you can also consider building brothels (female master Guide) gambling houses (gold coins) restaurants (gold coins) private schools (materials)

The above suggestions for beginners: Points 4 and 5 can be selected by the player's preferences!

notes.title: Game launch announcement
notes.content:
Overview
Preview Overview of the Launched Content:
[King's Route] It will be released in the form of a visual novel game. Players can experience the intertwining of power and the insidious tracks as if they were on the scene. Every choice you make is related to the safety of the entire Daxia and yourself. The King's Route consists of a total of 12 chapters, with a word count exceeding 100,000 words. Currently, the first-round release is the content of the first two chapters. The subsequent articles have all been completed, and it will meet everyone as soon as possible after the art department finishes perfecting the interface.

[Protagonist's Route] With business management and construction as the main gameplay form, players will play the role of a vassal king of a different surname at the border and build a border kingdom with their own hands, develop technology, and strengthen their strength. Overthrowing the current dynasty's rule in one fell swoop and ascending the throne by force is not really far away. All functions of the Protagonist's Route have been fully improved, waiting for you to explore. For players who are playing this type of game for the first time, they can go to the community to read the recommended beginner's guide.

[Characters] Currently, at the initial launch, there are a total of 5 female protagonists accompanying the players. There are more than 30 other various NPC characters, bringing you an immersive experience.

[Overview of Subsequent Updates]
1. Complete all content updates for the King's Route.
2. Listen to and modify some content and feedback according to players' opinions.
3. Launch subsequent free major update content.
